projection.method: Every method, server→client request, and event is taken from the upstream-generated OpenRPC contract, whose names equal the contract registry and the registered handler table of the same checkout. Hooks come from VALID_HOOKS by literal evaluation.
limitations: Contract models are enforced at dispatch for unknown params keys only; production logs, rather than rejects, a result or payload that violates its model, so runtime captures remain the occurrence authority.
OpenModel payloads (additionalProperties true) admit producer-owned fields that the contract does not enumerate.
Contract declarations establish legal shape and existence, not runtime reachability.

serverRequests.summary: Click / type / scroll / annotate inside the in-app browser preview.

serverRequests.name: preview.read
serverRequests.summary: Read the in-app browser preview's text (JSON text answer).

serverRequests.name: secret
serverRequests.summary: Masked value for a named env var (skills / setup flows).

serverRequests.name: sudo
serverRequests.summary: Masked sudo password for the terminal tool.

serverRequests.name: terminal.read
serverRequests.summary: Read the visible in-app terminal buffer (JSON text answer).

serverRequests.name: tour
serverRequests.summary: Drive a guided tour highlight in the desktop renderer.

serverRequests.name: vault.code
serverRequests.summary: A one-time / 2FA code the user reads from their device.

serverRequests.name: vault.save_login
serverRequests.summary: Save a login for a site the agent is about to fill; the answer is JSON {identifier, password}.

serverRequests.name: vault.unlock_prompt
serverRequests.summary: Master password to unlock an external password manager for this session.

serverRequests.name: window.read
serverRequests.summary: Enumerate the native window below the app (JSON text answer).

events.name: agent.terminal.output
events.summary: Output chunk from an agent-owned background process.

events.name: background.complete
events.summary: A /background side agent finished.

events.name: billing.step_up.verification
events.summary: Device-flow URL + code for the billing scope step-up; the client opens the browser.

events.name: bot_relay.outbox.pending
events.summary: A bot-relay outbox envelope is queued; drain it.

events.name: browser.controller.cancel
events.summary: Withdraw a pending controller command.

events.name: browser.controller.command
events.summary: Dispatch one browser action to the attached controller.

events.name: browser.progress
events.summary: Browser (CDP) connect / install progress line.

events.name: btw.complete
events.summary: A /btw side question was answered.

events.name: connection.request
events.summary: A connection operation opened on this session; the desktop renders its card.

events.name: connection.update
events.summary: One transition or the settlement of an open connection operation.

events.name: cron.changed
events.summary: cron/jobs.json moved; refetch the cron list.

events.name: display.install.done
events.summary: The install ended (0 ok, -1 cancelled, -2 no sudo: the command to run by hand was streamed).

events.name: display.install.log
events.summary: One line of package-manager output.

events.name: display.lease
events.summary: The takeover lease changed hands; every client repaints.

events.name: display.status
events.summary: This profile's screen started or stopped (also for transitions made outside hermes serve).

events.name: error
events.summary: A session-level failure outside a turn (agent init, model switch, compression, resume).

events.name: gateway.ready
events.summary: First frame of a connection: the resolved skin, the change-event capability and the replay epoch.

events.name: layout.apply
events.summary: Apply a named desktop layout preset.

events.name: message.complete
events.summary: The turn ended: final text, usage and outcome.

events.name: message.delta
events.summary: One streamed chunk of the assistant reply.

events.name: message.interim
events.summary: Interim assistant commentary (text beside tool calls) sealed as its own segment.

events.name: message.reaction
events.summary: The agent reacted to a message; paint it live.

events.name: message.start
events.summary: A turn began streaming; no payload.

events.name: moa.aggregating
events.summary: The MoA aggregator started.

events.name: moa.phase
events.summary: MoA phase transition (currently only ``aggregator``).

events.name: moa.progress
events.summary: MoA reference fan-out progress (n/total).

events.name: moa.reference
events.summary: One MoA reference model's output.

events.name: notice
events.summary: Informational one-liner for the session (capabilities refreshed).

events.name: notification.clear
events.summary: Withdraw the notice with this key.

events.name: notification.show
events.summary: Show / replace a keyed out-of-band notice (toast or status bar).

events.name: pairing.changed
events.summary: Pairing state moved; refetch pairing.

events.name: pane.reveal
events.summary: Focus / reveal a named desktop pane.

events.name: pet.changed
events.summary: The active pet / its spritesheet changed (watcher).

events.name: pet.generate.progress
events.summary: Pet base-draft generation progress.

events.name: pet.hatch.progress
events.summary: Pet hatch (row drawing) progress.

events.name: platforms.changed
events.summary: gateway_state.json moved; refetch platform status.

events.name: preview.close
events.summary: Close the preview pane or one tab.

events.name: preview.open
events.summary: Open a URL / file in the desktop preview pane.

events.name: preview.restart.complete
events.summary: The hidden preview-restart agent finished.

events.name: preview.restart.progress
events.summary: Progress line from the preview-restart agent.

events.name: reaction
events.summary: Affection reaction detected in the user's message (hearts etc.).

events.name: reasoning.available
events.summary: A completed reasoning block (non-streaming providers).

events.name: reasoning.delta
events.summary: One streamed chunk of the model's reasoning.

events.name: request.cancel
events.summary: The backend withdrew an open server→client request; clear the matching card only.

events.name: review.summary
events.summary: Background review of the last turn finished.

events.name: session.control.update
events.summary: Persisted goal / loop / heartbeat state changed.

events.name: session.info
events.summary: Live session settings snapshot (``server._session_info``); also the ``info`` of create/resume/activate.

events.name: session.reclaimed
events.summary: The backend reclaimed a live session out from under its clients.

events.name: session.resume_progress
events.summary: Deferred resume hydration progress.

events.name: session.title
events.summary: Auto-titling renamed the session (``session_id`` is the stored key).

events.name: session.usage
events.summary: Mid-turn usage tick; message.complete carries the authoritative final usage.

events.name: sessions.changed
events.summary: state.db moved; refetch the session list.

events.name: setup.ready
events.summary: The free-tier bootstrap finished (broadcast); the desktop's setup gate reads the record.

events.name: skin.changed
events.summary: The active skin moved (name switch or live colour edit); repaint from this palette.

events.name: status.update
events.summary: Transient status line (kind: status, lifecycle, compacting, goal, loop, heartbeat, process, …).

events.name: subagent.complete
events.summary: A child finished (status + observability rollup).

events.name: subagent.progress
events.summary: Batched tool-name progress from a child.

events.name: subagent.spawn_requested
events.summary: delegate_task accepted a child goal (before the child starts).

events.name: subagent.start
events.summary: A delegated child started running.

events.name: subagent.thinking
events.summary: A child's reasoning chunk.

events.name: subagent.tool
events.summary: A child called a tool.

events.name: terminal.close
events.summary: An agent-owned background process closed.

events.name: thinking.delta
events.summary: Legacy thinking-text chunk (thinking_callback).

events.name: tip.show
events.summary: Point at a desktop element with a one-line tip bubble.

events.name: todo.updated
events.summary: Full todo snapshot after a todo tool ran.

events.name: tool.complete
events.summary: A tool call finished: parsed result, summary, optional diff / todo snapshot.

events.name: tool.generating
events.summary: The model is emitting a tool call's arguments.

events.name: tool.output_risk
events.summary: Tool output was classified as risky (prompt-injection / secret findings).

events.name: tool.start
events.summary: A tool call began (stable id + full args).

events.name: voice.interrupted
events.summary: Barge-in: the spoken interjection interrupted the turn; no payload.

events.name: voice.status
events.summary: Voice recorder state changed.

events.name: voice.transcript
events.summary: A voice capture produced text (or a stop phrase / silence limit).

events.name: wake.detected
events.summary: A wake phrase fired.
